seoTitle: EU VAT Rates by Country: Standard and Reduced
metaDescription: Standard, reduced, super-reduced and parking VAT rates for all 27 EU countries, with source and date. Works offline.
intro: A table of VAT rates for every EU member state, searchable by country.
why:
VAT rates differ widely, from 17% in Luxembourg to 27% in Hungary. The table is bundled in the page, so it works offline and shows its source and date.

Which goods get a reduced rate is set by each country and is not in this table. The source leaves out regional rates. Check your tax authority before invoicing.
howTo: Type a country code or name, or leave empty for all.
Read the rates and the source line.
